incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: regional routing errors increasing in eu-west-1 -> spill into eu-central. 90% error rate on /v1/generate for standard-tier. P95 latency rising. Pager: #pager: oncall=Maria, severity=sev2, runbook=https://confluence.redwood/infer/runbooks/routing-fallback

Maria (oncall): Acknowledge — jumping in. Can someone grab recent routing logs and confirm which fallback ladder triggered? @Lee pls.

Lee (sre): On it. Quick note: control-plane shows a flurry of conversions from `regional-tier` -> `fallback-a` around 14:03 UTC. Possible connectivity hiccup to eu-west-1 controller. Pulling proxy logs now.

Sam (infra): We're seeing elevated kube eviction churn on a subset of nodes in eu-west-1 starting 14:01 UTC. Node-pool autoscaler kicked but pods were rescheduled slowly. Might explain spillover.

Priya (product): Customer impact estimate? Any high-traffic customers affected (billing tier or dedicated customers)?

Devon (ml): Quick check: fallback-a is a different model variant (quantized v2) with compatible token schema. Noted some decoding errors in a few requests earlier, but not widespread.

Lee (sre): Pasting relevant snippets from proxy logs:
```
[14:03:12 UTC] route_decision: route_policy=region_preference, target=eu-west-1, fallback=eu-central
[14:03:12 UTC] route_action: candidate=eu-west-1, health=DEGRADED, selected=eu-central (tier=standard->standard_fallback)
[14:03:13 UTC] error: misroute_detected: model-compat-warning code=E201 details="kv-cache-mismatch on session"
```

Maria (oncall): So two things: 1) region level infra churn causing controller health flips; 2) fallback selected (eu-central) but some sessions experienced model compatibility warnings -> misroutes. Need to track timeline and the subset of tokens that failed.

Sam (infra): Node eviction root cause: node-level kernel OOM killer triggered due to memory pressure on a custom batcher process. Engineering deployed GC toggle at 13:58 which increased memory temporarily. Rolling that back now.

Priya (product): Customer list from telemetry for impacted requests (14:00-14:10): acct-42 (mid-market), acct-88 (SaaS), acct-ops (internal). ~1422 total failing requests, ~3.8% of global traffic in that window.

Lee (sre): Hypotheses (initial):
- H1: Autoscaler + GC toggle produced node instability -> regional controller reported degraded -> routing spilled to eu-central.
- H2: Fallback selection didn't include model-variant compatibility check for active sessions, causing KV cache mismatch (misroute) for resumed sessions.
- H3: Batcher memory change caused increased latency that exceeded controller thresholds and triggered aggressive reroutes.

Devon (ml): Evidence for H2: decoding errors have consistent signature: "kv-cache-mismatch" followed by short-lived token duplication. These align with sessions that were sticky to eu-west-1 and then moved mid-stream to fallback-a.

Maria (oncall): Mitigation steps taken so far:
- Sam rolled back GC toggle at 14:08 (status: rollback complete).
- Routing policy set to allow short-stickiness window (30s) to prefer previous model variant while session finishes (temporarily) at 14:12 by Lee.
- Alert thresholds adjusted to avoid thrashing (14:15).

Lee (sre): Current metrics (14:20): error rate down to 2.1% in eu-west-1, overall recover trending. No new controller flips in last 10m.

Priya (product): Noted customer comms: drafting a "brief" for impacted customers summarizing root cause and mitigations. Will coordinate with legal for wording.

Sam (infra): Follow-up tasks I propose (assigning):
- infra: run heap analysis across batcher containers and add guardrails to prevent OOM from GC toggles (assignee: Sam)
- routing: add model-compatibility check into fallback decision for active sessions (assignee: Lee)
- ml: add automated smoke check for KV-cache compatibility when moving sessions across model variants (assignee: Devon)
- product: notify customers and attach timeline (assignee: Priya)

Devon (ml): Quick repro plan for H2: create a session pinned to model-quant-v1, then trigger fast failover to quant-v2 mid-session and run our decoding fuzz harness. I can start that now and post logs.

Lee (sre): I've exported a condensed timeline for the RCA doc:
- 13:58 UTC: GC toggle deployed to batcher causing memory spike.
- 14:01 UTC: Node OOMs -> kube eviction -> controller reports DEGRADED.
- 14:03 UTC: Routing controller triggers failover/overflow to eu-central for some sessions.
- 14:03-14:06 UTC: Misroutes observed (kv-cache-mismatch) as sessions moved to fallback model-variant mid-stream.
- 14:08 UTC: GC toggle rollback initiated.
- 14:12 UTC: Temporary stickiness window applied.
- 14:20 UTC: Error rate back to baseline.

Maria (oncall): Good timeline. For the in-thread RCA, please paste relevant log archive link and mark any evidence items we should include verbatim.

Lee (sre): Uploaded logs to internal artifact store: https://artifacts.redwood/incidents/2190001111/logs.tar.gz (contains proxy, controller, and batcher traces). Key evidence files: proxy_14_03.log, controller_14_01.log, batcher_heapdump_14_05.

audit-bot: Audit: incident-start=2190001111, severity=2, oncall=Maria, responders=[Lee,Sam,Devon,Priya], archived_artifacts=[https://artifacts.redwood/incidents/2190001111/logs.tar.gz]

Priya (product): I'll draft customer note and share in #customer-comms for review. Also scheduling postmortem sync for tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

Sam (infra): I'll add a temporary guard in the deploy pipeline to block GC toggles in high-load pools until we have tests in place.

Devon (ml): Starting repro now, will post results (~20m). If I see token duplication I'll add it to evidence.

Maria (oncall): Thanks team. I'll escalate to Platform leadership with this thread summary and link artifacts. Keeping this thread open for RCA additions.

Lee (sre): Follow-up note: recommend a short-term patch to routing: when selecting fallback for active sessions, require model-compatibility check or short session drain instead of instant remap. I'll draft a change and post pr link in thread.

Maria (oncall): Closing live mitigation. Leaving thread for RCA write-up. If anything new comes up, ping @Maria. :white_check_mark:
